children: PROCEPT BioRobotics entered into a Third Amendment to its Loan and Security Agreement with Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce to extend the term loan maturity. The amendment moves the maturity date by 12 months, from Oct 1, 2027 to Oct 1, 2028, with other covenants unchanged. The change is expected to enhance financial flexibility by extending the company’s debt timeline.
